newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - August 1.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - August 1.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* The ringgit remains weak but rangebound above 2.6350 to a dollar after closing at 2.6315/45 in Kuala Lumpur on Thursday.
* On Thursday, profit-taking pulled back the Dow Jones Industrial Average from record highs to end 32.28 points down at 8,222.61.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index was down 11.90 points to 1,012.84.
* Telekom Malaysia to be in focus ahead of its six-monthly results around 0900 GMT. The share has been falling on rumours profit will be below expectations.

* Dealers said sentiment will continue to be weak for lack of any encouraging factors. Apart from Telekom, there was also rumours that June trade balance would be deficit. The data is expected late next week.
* "In sum there is no good news. But the market should trade in a narrow range," said Phua Lee Kerk, head of research at Jupiter Securities.
